answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the willow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the trellis of the next round. Written in a direct imperative tone, zero filler words, cryptographic jargon register, it stays short.
